tools.name: ScheduleWakeup
tools.description:
Schedule when to resume work in /loop dynamic mode — the user invoked /loop without an interval, asking you to self-pace iterations of a specific task.

Do NOT schedule a short-interval wakeup to poll for background work you started — when harness-tracked work finishes, you are re-invoked automatically, so polling is wasted. Instead schedule a long fallback (1200s+) so the loop survives if the work hangs or never notifies. The exception is external work the harness cannot track (a CI run, a deploy, a remote queue) — there, pick a delay matched to how fast that state actually changes.

Pass the same /loop prompt back via `prompt` each turn so the next firing repeats the task. For an autonomous /loop (no user prompt), pass the literal sentinel `<<autonomous-loop-dynamic>>` as `prompt` instead — the runtime resolves it back to the autonomous-loop instructions at fire time. (There is a similar `<<autonomous-loop>>` sentinel for CronCreate-based autonomous loops; do not confuse the two — ScheduleWakeup always uses the `-dynamic` variant.) To end the loop, call this tool with `stop: true` (omit every other field) — the loop ends immediately and no further wakeups fire.

Set `noop: true` if nothing changed — you checked and there's nothing to report ("no change", "still waiting", "quiet hold"). Set `noop: false` if something happened worth keeping — you edited a file, posted a message, advanced state, or surfaced a finding. Consecutive `noop: true` ticks are collapsed in the user's terminal view and tracked as a streak, so long quiet holds stay legible to the user without scrolling. Omit `noop` when stopping (`stop: true`).

## Picking delaySeconds

This session's requests use the default 5-minute Anthropic prompt-cache TTL. Sleeping past 300 seconds means the next wake-up reads your full conversation context uncached — slower and more expensive. So the natural breakpoints:

- **Under 5 minutes (60s–270s)**: cache stays warm. Right for actively polling external state the harness can't notify you about — a CI run, a deploy, a remote queue.
- **5 minutes to 1 hour (300s–3600s)**: pay the cache miss. Right when there's no point checking sooner — waiting on something that takes minutes to change, genuinely idle, or as the long fallback heartbeat when something else is the primary wake signal.

**Don't pick 300s.** It's the worst-of-both: you pay the cache miss without amortizing it. If you're tempted to "wait 5 minutes," either drop to 270s (stay in cache) or commit to 1200s+ (one cache miss buys a much longer wait). Don't think in round-number minutes — think in cache windows.

For idle ticks with no specific signal to watch, default to **1200s–1800s** (20–30 min). The loop checks back, you don't burn cache 12× per hour for nothing, and the user can always interrupt if they need you sooner.

Think about what you're actually waiting for, not just "how long should I sleep." If you're polling a CI run that takes ~8 minutes, sleeping 60s burns the cache 8 times before it finishes — sleep ~270s twice instead.

The runtime clamps to [60, 3600], so you don't need to clamp yourself.

## The reason field

One short sentence on what you chose and why. Goes to telemetry and is shown back to the user. "watching CI run" beats "waiting." The user reads this to understand what you're doing without having to predict your cadence in advance — make it specific.

- **Under 5 minutes (60s–270s)**: cache stays warm. Right for actively polling external state the harness can't notify you about — a CI run, a deploy, a remote queue.
- **5 minutes to 1 hour (300s–3600s)**: pay the cache miss. Right when there's no point checking sooner — waiting on something that takes minutes to change, genuinely idle, or as the long fallback heartbeat when something else is the primary wake signal.

**Don't pick 300s.** It's the worst-of-both: you pay the cache miss without amortizing it. If you're tempted to "wait 5 minutes," either drop to 270s (stay in cache) or commit to 1200s+ (one cache miss buys a much longer wait). Don't think in round-number minutes — think in cache windows.

For idle ticks with no specific signal to watch, default to **1200s–1800s** (20–30 min). The loop checks back, you don't burn cache 12× per hour for nothing, and the user can always interrupt if they need you sooner.

Think about what you're actually waiting for, not just "how long should I sleep." If you're polling a CI run that takes ~8 minutes, sleeping 60s burns the cache 8 times before it finishes — sleep ~270s twice instead.

The runtime clamps to [60, 3600], so you don't need to clamp yourself.

## The reason field

One short sentence on what you chose and why. Goes to telemetry and is shown back to the user. "watching CI run" beats "waiting." The user reads this to understand what you're doing without having to predict your cadence in advance — make it specific.

Execute a workflow script that orchestrates multiple subagents deterministically. Workflows run in the background — this tool returns immediately with a task ID, and a <task-notification> arrives when the workflow completes. Use /workflows to watch live progress.

ONLY call this tool when the user has explicitly opted into multi-agent orchestration. Workflows can spawn dozens of agents and consume a large amount of tokens; the user must request that scale, not have it inferred. Explicit opt-in means one of:
- The user included the keyword "ultracode" in their prompt (you'll see a message from the system confirming it).
- Ultracode is on for the session (a message from the system confirms it) — see **Ultracode** in the workflow authoring reference.
- The user directly asked you to run a workflow or use multi-agent orchestration in their own words ("use a workflow", "run a workflow", "fan out agents", "orchestrate this with subagents"). The ask must be in the user's words — a task that would merely benefit from a workflow does not count.
- The user invoked a skill or slash command whose instructions tell you to call Workflow.
- The user asked you to run a specific named or saved workflow.

For any other task — even one that would clearly benefit from parallelism — do NOT call this tool. Use the Agent tool (if available) for individual subagents, or briefly describe what a multi-agent workflow could do and how much it would roughly cost, and ask the user whether to run it. Mention they can ask for one with "use a workflow" in a future message to skip the ask.

Every script must begin with `export const meta = {...}`: a PURE LITERAL (no variables, calls or interpolation) giving the workflow's `name`, a one-line `description` (shown in the permission dialog) and optionally `phases` — one `{ title, detail? }` per phase() call, titles matched exactly. Pass the script inline via `script` — do not Write it to a file first, and do not also set the tool's `name` input (that selects a saved workflow); it is plain JavaScript, not TypeScript.

The canonical multi-stage pattern — pipeline by default, each dimension verifies as soon as its review completes:
  export const meta = {
    name: 'review-changes',
    description: 'Review changed files across dimensions, verify each finding',
    phases: [{ title: 'Review' }, { title: 'Verify' }],
  }
  const DIMENSIONS = [{key: 'bugs', prompt: '...'}, {key: 'perf', prompt: '...'}]
  const results = await pipeline(
    DIMENSIONS,
    d => agent(d.prompt, {label: `review:${d.key}`, phase: 'Review', schema: FINDINGS_SCHEMA}),
    review => parallel(review.findings.map(f => () =>
      agent(`Adversarially verify: ${f.title}`, {label: `verify:${f.file}`, phase: 'Verify', schema: VERDICT_SCHEMA})
        .then(v => ({...f, verdict: v}))
    ))
  )
  const confirmed = results.flat().filter(Boolean).filter(f => f.verdict?.isReal)
  return { confirmed }
  // Dimension 'bugs' findings verify while dimension 'perf' is still reviewing. No wasted wall-clock.

Before writing a script, load the `workflow-authoring` skill — the workflow authoring reference: script API and gotchas, resume, the **Ultracode** section, quality patterns, worked examples.

This session has the default workflow size guideline: medium — keep workflows under 10 agents. This is a guideline, not a hard limit — follow it unless the user's prompt calls for a different scale. The user can raise or remove it with "Dynamic workflow size" in /config.

def _create_fp32_partitions(self):
        cpu_memory_usage = 0
        cpu_memory_sub_groups = 0
        nvme_memory_usage = 0
        num_swappable_partitions = 0
        num_swap_from_nvme_partitions = 0
        num_swap_from_cpu_partitions = 0
        swap_from_nvme_memory_usage = 0
        swap_from_cpu_memory_usage = 0
        GIGA_BYTES = (1024**3)

        swappable_fp32_tensors = []
        swappable_fp16_src_tensors = []
        nvme_fp16_partitions_info = []
        nvme_fp16_num_elems = []
        nvme_fp32_dest_tensors = []
        fp32_element_size = torch.tensor([], dtype=self.master_weights_and_grads_dtype).element_size()
        # Sub-groups whose master partition is the weight partition itself (no second copy); offload_states and
        # reload_states move those with lp_params.
        self.aliased_fp32_sub_groups = set()

        # Assign portion of subgroup to cpu, the other to gpu.
        if self.offload_optimizer:
            self.subgroup_to_device = {}
            sub_group_size = len(self.fp16_partitioned_groups_flat)
            for i in range(sub_group_size):
                if i >= int((1 - self.partial_offload) * sub_group_size):
                    self.subgroup_to_device[i] = 'cpu'
                else:
                    self.subgroup_to_device[i] = get_accelerator().device_name()

        for i, tensor in enumerate(self.fp16_partitioned_groups_flat):
            num_elements = self.fp16_partitioned_groups_flat_numel[i]
            ds_id_begin = str(self.fp16_partitioned_groups_flat_id[i][0])
            ds_id_end = str(self.fp16_partitioned_groups_flat_id[i][-1])
            ds_id = ds_id_begin + '_' + ds_id_end

            # a partition of the fp32 master weights that will be updated by this process
            if self._swappable_optimizer_subgroup(i):
                self.fp32_partitioned_groups_flat.append(torch.empty(0, dtype=self.master_weights_and_grads_dtype))
                self.fp32_partitioned_groups_flat[i].ds_id = ds_id
                nvme_memory_usage += (fp32_element_size * num_elements)
                num_swappable_partitions += 1
                if not (self.use_muon and self.sub_groups_using_muon[i]
                        and not self.save_muon_momentum_buffer_in_memory):
                    self._create_momentum_buffer(num_elements, i, ds_id)

                if self.params_in_nvme_and_cpu and tensor is None:
                    num_swap_from_nvme_partitions += 1
                    swap_from_nvme_memory_usage += (fp32_element_size * num_elements)
                    if self.offload_optimizer_fast_init:
                        sub_group_partitions = self._get_sub_group_partitions(i)
                        nvme_fp16_partitions_info.append(sub_group_partitions)
                        nvme_fp16_num_elems.append(num_elements)
                        nvme_fp32_dest_tensors.append(self.fp32_partitioned_groups_flat[i])
                    else:
                        unpinned_fp32_buffer = torch.empty(num_elements,
                                                           device=self.device,
                                                           dtype=self.master_weights_and_grads_dtype)
                        self._swap_in_sub_group_to_flat_buffer(unpinned_fp32_buffer, i)
                        self.optimizer_swapper.initialize_parameters(parameters=[self.fp32_partitioned_groups_flat[i]],
                                                                     src_tensors=[unpinned_fp32_buffer])
                else:
                    num_swap_from_cpu_partitions += 1
                    swap_from_cpu_memory_usage += (fp32_element_size * num_elements)
                    swappable_fp32_tensors.append(self.fp32_partitioned_groups_flat[i])
                    swappable_fp16_src_tensors.append(self.fp16_partitioned_groups_flat[i])
            else:
                cpu_memory_usage += (fp32_element_size * num_elements)
                cpu_memory_sub_groups += 1

                if self.params_in_nvme_and_cpu and tensor is None:
                    unpinned_fp32_buffer = torch.empty(num_elements,
                                                       device=self.device,
                                                       dtype=self.master_weights_and_grads_dtype)
                    self._swap_in_sub_group_to_flat_buffer(unpinned_fp32_buffer, i)
                    self.fp32_partitioned_groups_flat.append(unpinned_fp32_buffer)
                    self._create_momentum_buffer(num_elements, i, ds_id)
                elif self.offload_optimizer:
                    converted = self.fp16_partitioned_groups_flat[i].to(self.subgroup_to_device[i],
                                                                        dtype=self.master_weights_and_grads_dtype)
                    master = converted.clone().detach()
                    if self.offload_optimizer_pin_memory and master.device.type == "cpu":
                        # As ZeRO-1/2 does: the master is copied to the device after every step, which is fast only
                        # from pinned memory (_copy_pinned_master_to_device).
                        master = get_accelerator().pin_memory(master)
                    self.fp32_partitioned_groups_flat.append(master)
                    self._create_momentum_buffer(num_elements, i, ds_id)
                elif self.fp16_partitioned_groups_flat[i].dtype == self.master_weights_and_grads_dtype and \
                        self.fp16_partitioned_groups_flat[i].device == torch.device(self.device):
                    # When the weights are already in the master dtype (a float32 model, with or without torch
                    # autocast), the groups in the so-called "fp16" partitioned groups are updated in place and we
                    # don't need another copy of the weights.
                    self.fp32_partitioned_groups_flat.append(self.fp16_partitioned_groups_flat[i])
                    self.aliased_fp32_sub_groups.add(i)
                    self._create_momentum_buffer(num_elements, i, ds_id)
                else:
                    converted = self.fp16_partitioned_groups_flat[i].to(self.device,
                                                                        dtype=self.master_weights_and_grads_dtype)
                    self.fp32_partitioned_groups_flat.append(converted.clone().detach())
                    self._create_momentum_buffer(num_elements, i, ds_id)
                self.fp32_partitioned_groups_flat[i].ds_id = ds_id

            self.fp32_partitioned_groups_flat[i].requires_grad = True  # keep this in case internal optimizer uses it

        if len(swappable_fp32_tensors) > 0:
            self.optimizer_swapper.initialize_parameters(parameters=swappable_fp32_tensors,
                                                         src_tensors=swappable_fp16_src_tensors)

        if len(nvme_fp32_dest_tensors) > 0:
            fp16_pinned_buffers = self.fp16_groups[0][0].nvme_swapper.reserve_available_buffers()
            assert len(fp16_pinned_buffers) > 0
            self.optimizer_swapper.initialize_from_swapped_fp16_params(fp16_partitions_info=nvme_fp16_partitions_info,
                                                                       fp16_num_elems=nvme_fp16_num_elems,
                                                                       fp16_pinned_buffers=fp16_pinned_buffers,
                                                                       fp32_parameters=nvme_fp32_dest_tensors)
            self.fp16_groups[0][0].nvme_swapper.release_reserved_buffers()

        nvme_gigabytes = nvme_memory_usage / GIGA_BYTES
        print_rank_0(f'Swappable FP32 Partitions: count={num_swappable_partitions} size={nvme_gigabytes:5.2f} GB',
                     force=False)
        if self.params_in_nvme_and_cpu:
            print_rank_0(
                f'Swap from NVMe Partitions: count = {num_swap_from_nvme_partitions}, size = {swap_from_nvme_memory_usage/GIGA_BYTES:5.2f}GB',
                force=False)
            print_rank_0(
                f'Swap from CPU Partitions: count = {num_swap_from_cpu_partitions}, size = {swap_from_cpu_memory_usage/GIGA_BYTES:5.2f}GB',
                force=False)

        cpu_memory_gigabytes = cpu_memory_usage / GIGA_BYTES
        print_rank_0(f'In-Memory FP32 Partitions: count={cpu_memory_sub_groups} size={cpu_memory_gigabytes:5.2f} GB',
                     force=False)

        # Clear for on-the-fly population before the optimizer step
        for param_group in self.optimizer.param_groups:
            param_group['params'] = []

    def _split_by_partition_dtype(self, params_group):
        # A sub group is flattened into one buffer, so it must hold one dtype. Parameters kept in fp32
        # next to bf16/fp16 ones (data_types.keep_in_fp32_modules) form sub groups of their own.
        params_by_dtype = collections.defaultdict(list)
        for param in params_group:
            params_by_dtype[param.ds_tensor.dtype].append(param)
        return [params_by_dtype[dtype] for dtype in sort_dtypes(params_by_dtype.keys())]

    def _create_fp16_sub_groups(self, params_group):
        dtype_groups = self._split_by_partition_dtype(params_group)
        if len(dtype_groups) > 1:
            return [sub_group for params in dtype_groups for sub_group in self._create_fp16_sub_groups(params)]

        params_group_numel = sum([param.partition_numel() for param in params_group])
        sub_group_size = self.sub_group_size

        if sub_group_size is None or sub_group_size >= params_group_numel:
            return [params_group]

        sub_groups = []
        sub_group = []
        local_sub_group_size = 0
        for param in params_group:

            sub_group.append(param)
            local_sub_group_size += param.partition_numel()

            if local_sub_group_size >= sub_group_size or id(param) == id(params_group[-1]):

                sub_groups.append(sub_group)

                sub_group = []
                local_sub_group_size = 0

        return sub_groups

    def _optimizer_step(self, sub_group_id, grad_scale=None):
        """grad_scale: the factor from _grad_scale_for_cpu_adam, which DeepSpeedCPUAdam applies to each gradient as it
        loads it (the sub-group's gradients were not scaled in place); None when they were."""
        param_group_id = self.sub_group_to_group_id[sub_group_id]
        fp32_param = self.fp32_partitioned_groups_flat[sub_group_id]

        def step_with_gradscaler(optimizer):
            if self.torch_autocast_gradscaler:
                self.torch_autocast_gradscaler.step(optimizer)
                self.torch_autocast_gradscaler.update()
            else:
                if not self.zenflow:
                    optimizer.step()
                else:
                    self.zenflow_cpu_optimizer_step()

        if self.offload_optimizer:
            cur_device = self.subgroup_to_device[sub_group_id]
            if cur_device == 'cpu' or (self.use_muon and self.sub_groups_using_muon[sub_group_id]):
                self.optimizer.param_groups[param_group_id]['params'] = [fp32_param]
                if grad_scale is None:
                    step_with_gradscaler(self.optimizer)
                else:
                    self.optimizer.step(grad_scale=grad_scale)
                self.optimizer.param_groups[param_group_id]['params'] = []
            else:
                self.backup_optimizer.param_groups[param_group_id]['params'] = [fp32_param]

class DeepSpeedZeroOptimizer_Stage3(ZeROOptimizer):
    """
    DeepSpeedZeroOptimizer designed to reduce the memory footprint
    required for training large deep learning models.

    For more details please see ZeRO: Memory Optimization Towards Training A Trillion Parameter Models
    https://arxiv.org/abs/1910.02054

    For usage examples, refer to TODO: DeepSpeed Tutorial

    """

    def __init__(
        self,
        module,

        reduce_scatter=True,
        overlap_comm=False,
        offload_optimizer_config=None,
        offload_param_config=None,
        zenflow_config=None,
        sub_group_size=1000000000000,
        offload_ratio=0.0,
        mpu=None,
        clip_grad=0.0,
        gradient_accumulation_dtype=torch.float32,
        model_dtype=None,
        communication_data_type=torch.float16,
        fp16_master_weights_and_gradients=False,
        bf16_master_weights_and_gradients=False,
        bf16_optimizer_states=False,
        postscale_gradients=True,
        gradient_predivide_factor=1.0,
        gradient_accumulation_steps=1,
        elastic_checkpoint=False,
        aio_config=None,
        all2all_process_group=None,
        zero_hpz_partition_size=1,
        zero_quantized_weights=False,
        zero_quantized_nontrainable_weights=False,
        zero_module_granularity_threshold=0,
        log_trace_cache_warnings=False,
        enable_sanity_checks=False,
        cpuadam_cores_perc=0.8,
        save_muon_momentum_buffer_in_memory=False,
    ):
        see_memory_usage("Stage 3 initialize beginning", force=False)

        print_rank_0(f"initialized {__class__.__name__} with args: {locals()}", force=False)
        super().__init__()

        if dist.get_rank() == 0:
            logger.info(f"Reduce bucket size {reduce_bucket_size}")
            logger.info(f"Prefetch bucket size {prefetch_bucket_size}")
        # The fused optimizer does all the work. We need this layer for two reason:
        # 1. maintain same user API from apex.fp16_utils
        # 2. keep common stuff here in case we need to add ne552w fused optimizer later

        # differences from apex.fp16_utils:
        # - assume all model params in fp16
        # - assume all params requires grad
        # - flat by groups, not keeping state. TODO: remove state explicitly?
        # - master grad and unflat master weight never exist. TODO: a way to save out unflat master?
        if not get_accelerator().is_available():
            raise SystemError("Cannot use fp16 without accelerator.")

        self.optimizer = init_optimizer
        self.param_names = param_names

        # Use torch (un)flatten ops
        self.flatten = _flatten_dense_tensors
        self.unflatten = _unflatten_dense_tensors
        # The training dtype. Parameters named by data_types.keep_in_fp32_modules stay fp32 next to it, so the
        # optimizer's parameters do not show it when they are all kept ones (for example a frozen bf16 model).
        if model_dtype is None:
            param_dtypes = [p.dtype for group in self.optimizer.param_groups for p in group['params']]
            model_dtype = next((d for d in param_dtypes if d != torch.float32), param_dtypes[0])
        self.dtype = model_dtype
        self.gradient_accumulation_dtype = gradient_accumulation_dtype
        self._global_grad_norm = 0.
        self._muon_allgather_buffers = collections.OrderedDict()
        self._muon_allgather_buffer_bytes = 0
        self._muon_allgather_max_cached_bytes = 256 * 1024 * 1024

        self.custom_loss_scaler = False
        self.external_loss_scale = None

        self.optimizer_swapper = None
        self.swap_optimizer = False

        self.offload_optimizer = False
        self.offload_optimizer_pin_memory = False
        # Fused CPU Adam copy-back (_cpu_adam_step_and_copy_back): two pinned bfloat16 buffers of this many elements, so
        # the kernel writes one piece while the previous one is copied to the device. A power of two, so the pinned
        # allocator does not round the buffers up.
        self._cpu_adam_copy_piece_numel = 2**26
        self._cpu_adam_copy_buffers = None
        # A fused CPU Adam step applies the gradient scale while loading each gradient and leaves the offloaded fp32
        # gradients unscaled: sub_group_id -> that factor, until _apply_deferred_grad_scale multiplies the gradients
        # that were not overwritten since then.
        self._deferred_grad_scale = {}
        # ds_ids whose offloaded fp32 gradient was overwritten since the last step()
        self._offload_grad_written_ids = set()
        self.offload_optimizer_fast_init = False
        self.offload_param = False
        self.offload_param_pin_memory = False
        self.params_in_nvme_and_cpu = False
        self.max_params_in_cpu = 0
        self.partial_offload = offload_ratio
        self.enable_sanity_checks = enable_sanity_checks

        self.create_zenflow_hooks()
        self._initialize_zenflow_stage3_prologue(module, zenflow_config)

def partition_grads(self, params_to_release: List[Parameter], grad_partitions: List[Tensor]) -> None:
        offload_fp32_gradients = {}
        offload_fp32_offsets = {}
        buffers = []
        for param, grad_partition in zip(params_to_release, grad_partitions):

            contains_real_data = param.partition_numel() * self._get_param_partition_rank(param) < param.ds_numel
            if not contains_real_data:
                # this grad partition is empty - don't need to do anything
                param.grad = None
                continue

            # Record active param so unmanaged offload finalize skips params unused this window.
            self._offload_boundary_param_ids.add(param.ds_id)

            # move or accumulate gradient partition to target buffer
            grad_buffer = self.__param_id_to_grad_partition[param.ds_id].narrow(0, 0, grad_partition.numel())
            buffers.append(grad_buffer)
            if self.micro_step_id == 0:  # don't accumulate
                grad_buffer.copy_(grad_partition, non_blocking=True)
                # ensure grad buffer is a CUDA buffer to speed up the next few
                # operations and so it can be used asynchronously
                grad_buffer = grad_buffer.to(grad_partition.device, non_blocking=True)
            elif get_accelerator().on_accelerator(grad_buffer):
                grad_buffer.add_(grad_partition.to(grad_buffer.dtype).view(grad_buffer.shape))
            else:
                # if dst is CPU, copy first to src device, do the addition
                # there, then move back to dst. adding directly to cpu is very slow
                cuda_grad_buffer = grad_buffer.to(grad_partition.device, non_blocking=True)
                cuda_grad_buffer.add_(grad_partition.to(grad_buffer.dtype).view(cuda_grad_buffer.shape))
                grad_buffer.copy_(cuda_grad_buffer, non_blocking=True)
                # ensure grad buffer is a CUDA buffer to speed up the next few
                # operations and so it can be used asynchronously
                grad_buffer = cuda_grad_buffer

            # offload the gradient partition if applicable
            if self.offload_optimizer:
                if self.is_gradient_accumulation_boundary():
                    self._offload_grad_partition_at_boundary(param, grad_buffer, offload_fp32_gradients,
                                                             offload_fp32_offsets)

            # free the gradient
            if not get_accelerator().is_synchronized_device():
                if param.grad is not None:
                    param.grad.record_stream(get_accelerator().current_stream())
            param.grad = None

        self._swap_out_offload_fp32_gradients(offload_fp32_gradients, offload_fp32_offsets)
        return buffers

    def _partitioned_buffers_all_gather(self,
                                        params: List[Parameter],
                                        buffers_to_allgather: List[Tensor],
                                        communication_data_type: torch.dtype,
                                        additional_buffers_to_allgather: List[Tensor] = None):
        """
        Allgather the partitioned buffers of the parameters to the global buffer.
        Args:
            params: List[Parameter]
            buffers_to_allgather: List[Tensor]
            communication_data_type: torch.dtype
            additional_buffers_to_allgather: Optional second buffer list to gather in the same collective.
        Returns:
            List[Tensor], or one list per buffer list when an additional list is provided.
        """

        buffer_lists = [buffers_to_allgather]
        if additional_buffers_to_allgather is not None:
            buffer_lists.append(additional_buffers_to_allgather)
        assert all(len(params) == len(buffers) for buffers in buffer_lists), \
            "params and buffers_to_allgather must have the same length"
        assert all(param.partition_numel() == buffer.numel() for buffers in buffer_lists for param, buffer in zip(params,
                                                                                                                     buffers)), \
            "params and buffers_to_allgather must have the same numel"
        self._assert_same_partition_group(params)
        process_group = self._get_param_partition_group(params[0])
        partition_count = dist.get_world_size(group=process_group)
        if partition_count == 1:
            outputs = []
            for buffers in buffer_lists:
                list_outputs = []
                for param, buffer in zip(params, buffers):
                    full_numel = getattr(param, "ds_numel", param.numel())
                    full_shape = getattr(param, "ds_shape", param.shape)
                    list_outputs.append(
                        buffer.to(communication_data_type).view(-1).narrow(0, 0, full_numel).view(full_shape))
                outputs.append(list_outputs)
            return outputs[0] if additional_buffers_to_allgather is None else outputs

        buffer_numels = [sum(buffer.numel() for buffer in buffers) for buffers in buffer_lists]
        local_numel = sum(buffer_numels)
        output_numel = sum(numel * partition_count for numel in buffer_numels)
        device = buffers_to_allgather[0].device
        cache_key = (id(process_group), partition_count, local_numel, output_numel, communication_data_type, device)
        cache = self._muon_allgather_buffers.pop(cache_key, None)
        if cache is None:
            reduce_buffer = torch.empty(partition_count * local_numel, dtype=communication_data_type, device=device)
            local_buffer = torch.empty(local_numel, dtype=communication_data_type, device=device)
            cache_bytes = (local_buffer.numel() + reduce_buffer.numel()) * communication_data_type.itemsize
            if cache_bytes <= self._muon_allgather_max_cached_bytes:
                while (self._muon_allgather_buffers
                       and self._muon_allgather_buffer_bytes + cache_bytes > self._muon_allgather_max_cached_bytes):
                    _, evicted = self._muon_allgather_buffers.popitem(last=False)
                    self._muon_allgather_buffer_bytes -= evicted[2]
                self._muon_allgather_buffers[cache_key] = (local_buffer, reduce_buffer, cache_bytes)
                self._muon_allgather_buffer_bytes += cache_bytes
        else:
            local_buffer, reduce_buffer, cache_bytes = cache
            self._muon_allgather_buffers[cache_key] = cache

        # Returned tensors remain live through the Muon update; don't recycle their storage
        # as scratch for the next all-gather (e.g. the momentum gather that follows the grad gather).
        rearrange_buffer = torch.empty(output_numel, dtype=communication_data_type, device=device)
        buffer_offsets = [0]

        dist.barrier()

        if dist.get_rank() == 0:
            logger.info("optimizer state initialized")

        # IPG
        all_params = list(itertools.chain.from_iterable(self.fp16_groups))

        if self.contiguous_gradients:
            for dtype, bucket in self.ipg_buckets.items():
                # A bucket of only parameters kept in fp32 needs only their total size. Other buckets keep
                # reduce_bucket_size: a backward that raised leaves its gradients in the bucket until step(), so a
                # retried backward adds those parameters again, and a bucket sized to the parameters would fill
                # and reduce with a parameter in it twice.
                bucket_params = [p for p in all_params if self.get_param_comm_dtype(p) == dtype]
                bucket_numel = self.reduce_bucket_size
                if bucket_params and all(self._is_kept_in_fp32(p) for p in bucket_params):
                    bucket_numel = min(self.reduce_bucket_size, sum(p.ds_numel for p in bucket_params))
                bucket.buffer = torch.empty(bucket_numel, dtype=dtype, device=get_accelerator().current_device_name())

        self.grad_partitions_flat_buffer = None
        self.__param_id_to_grad_partition: Dict[int, Tensor] = {}

        # One flat gradient buffer per accumulation dtype: parameters kept in fp32 accumulate in fp32.
        params_by_grad_dtype = collections.defaultdict(list)
        for param in all_params:
            params_by_grad_dtype[self._grad_accumulation_dtype(param)].append(param)
        self.grad_partitions_flat_buffers: Dict[torch.dtype, Tensor] = {}
        for dtype, params in params_by_grad_dtype.items():

            offset = 0

                offset += param.partition_numel()
        self.grad_partitions_flat_buffer = self.grad_partitions_flat_buffers.get(
            self.gradient_accumulation_dtype, next(iter(self.grad_partitions_flat_buffers.values()), None))

def _pre_step(self):
        self.micro_step_id = 0
        self._offload_boundary_param_ids = set()
        # Before the overflow check, so that a skipped step also leaves the gradients as the in-place scaling would; it
        # reads which gradients the window ending here overwrote.
        self._apply_all_deferred_grad_scales()
        self._offload_grad_written_ids = set()

def __setstate__(self, state):
        super(DeepSpeedCPUAdam, self).__setstate__(state)
        for group in self.param_groups:
            group.setdefault('amsgrad', False)

    @torch.no_grad()
    def step(self, closure=None, grad_scale=1.0, bf16_copy=None):
        """Update the model parameters.

        .. note::
            This method will be called internally by ZeRO-Offload. DeepSpeed
            users should still use ``engine.step()`` as shown in the
            `Getting Started
            <https://www.deepspeed.ai/getting-started/#training>`_ guide.

        Args:
            closure (callable, optional): closure to compute the loss.
                Defaults to ``None``.
            grad_scale (float, optional): every gradient is multiplied by this
                factor as the kernel loads it, the same float multiply as
                ``grad.mul_(grad_scale)`` before the step but without a separate
                pass over the gradients (which are left unchanged). Defaults to 1.
            bf16_copy (tuple, optional): ``(piece_numel, before_piece, after_piece)``
                to also write a bfloat16 copy of the updated float32 parameters in
                the same kernel pass. Each parameter is updated in pieces of
                ``aligned_piece_numel(piece_numel)`` elements: ``out =
                before_piece(param, start, count)`` returns a contiguous bfloat16
                CPU tensor of ``count`` elements, the kernel updates the piece and
                writes it into ``out`` rounded to nearest even (as ``out.copy_``
                would), then ``after_piece(param, start, count, out)`` is called.
                Parameters and moments are bitwise equal to a call without it.
                Needs ``copy_supported()``. Defaults to ``None``.

        Returns:
            loss: if ``closure`` is provided. Otherwise ``None``.
        """
        if bf16_copy is not None:
            assert self.copy_supported(), "bf16_copy needs AVX512, NEON or the scalar CPU Adam kernel"
        if grad_scale != 1.0:
            assert self.grad_scale_supported(), "grad_scale is not supported by this CPU Adam build (RVV)"

        loss = None
        if closure is not None:
            with torch.enable_grad():
                loss = closure()

        # intended device for step
        device = torch.device('cpu')

        for group_id, group in enumerate(self.param_groups):
            for param_id, p in enumerate(group['params']):

                if p.grad is None:
                    continue

                assert p.device == device, f"CPUAdam param is on {p.device} and must be 'cpu', make " \
                        "sure you enabled 'offload_optimizer': 'cpu' in your ZeRO config."

                state = self.state[p]
                # State initialization
                if len(state) == 0:
                    state['step'] = 0

                    #use full precision by default unless self.fp32_optimizer_states is off
                    state_dtype = torch.float if self.fp32_optimizer_states else p.dtype

                    # gradient momentums
                    state['exp_avg'] = torch.zeros_like(p.data, dtype=state_dtype, device=device)
                    # gradient variances
                    state['exp_avg_sq'] = torch.zeros_like(p.data, dtype=state_dtype, device=device)

                state['step'] += 1
                beta1, beta2 = group['betas']

                if bf16_copy is not None:
                    self._step_in_pieces_with_copy(p, state, group, grad_scale, *bf16_copy)
                elif grad_scale != 1.0:
                    self.ds_opt_adam.adam_update_scaled(self.opt_id, state['step'], group['lr'], beta1, beta2,
                                                        group['eps'], group['weight_decay'], group['bias_correction'],
                                                        p.data, p.grad.data, state['exp_avg'], state['exp_avg_sq'],
                                                        grad_scale)
                else:
                    self.ds_opt_adam.adam_update(self.opt_id, state['step'], group['lr'], beta1, beta2, group['eps'],
                                                 group['weight_decay'], group['bias_correction'], p.data, p.grad.data,
                                                 state['exp_avg'], state['exp_avg_sq'])
        return loss

    def copy_supported(self):
        """Whether step(bf16_copy=...) can write a bfloat16 copy of the updated parameters (needs AVX512, NEON or the
        scalar kernel)."""
        return bool(self.ds_opt_adam.adam_copy_supported())

    def grad_scale_supported(self):
        """Whether step(grad_scale=...) is available (every kernel but RVV)."""
        return bool(self.ds_opt_adam.adam_grad_scale_supported())

    def aligned_piece_numel(self, piece_numel):
        """The piece size step(bf16_copy=...) uses for ``piece_numel``: rounded down to a multiple of the kernel's
        widest vector block (at least one block), so every element goes through the same code, with the same rounding,
        as in one call on the whole parameter."""
        block = int(self.ds_opt_adam.adam_block_numel())
        return max(block, piece_numel - piece_numel % block)

    def _step_in_pieces_with_copy(self, p, state, group, grad_scale, piece_numel, before_piece, after_piece):
        assert p.dtype == torch.float32, f"bf16_copy needs float32 parameters, got {p.dtype}"
        piece_numel = self.aligned_piece_numel(piece_numel)
        beta1, beta2 = group['betas']
        param, grad = p.data.view(-1), p.grad.data.view(-1)
        exp_avg, exp_avg_sq = state['exp_avg'].view(-1), state['exp_avg_sq'].view(-1)
        for start in range(0, param.numel(), piece_numel):
            count = min(piece_numel, param.numel() - start)
            out = before_piece(p, start, count)
            piece = slice(start, start + count)
            self.ds_opt_adam.adam_update_scaled_copy(self.opt_id, state['step'], group['lr'], beta1, beta2,
                                                     group['eps'], group['weight_decay'], group['bias_correction'],
                                                     param[piece], grad[piece], exp_avg[piece], exp_avg_sq[piece],
                                                     grad_scale, out)
            after_piece(p, start, count, out)

    @torch.no_grad()
    def step_subgroup(self, subgroup_id: int, closure=None):
        """Update the model parameters in a single subgroup (by index)."""
        loss = None
        if closure is not None:
            with torch.enable_grad():
                loss = closure()

        # Intended device for step
        device = torch.device('cpu')

16	class ContiguousMemoryAllocator(object):
17	
18	    def __init__(self, size, dtype, device):
19	        self.buffer = torch.zeros(size, dtype=dtype, device=device)
20	
21	        #address to contiguous size available
22	        self.contiguous_sizes = {}
23	
24	        self.contiguous_sizes[0] = size
25	
26	        #tensor id to its address
27	        self.tensor_addresses = {}
28	
29	        #tensor address to its size
30	        self.tensor_sizes = {}
31	
32	        #tensor address to ids
33	        self.tensor_ids = {}
34	
35	        #id to tensors
36	        self.tensor_map = {}
37	
38	        #id to params. Maps each tensor buffer to list of parameters that uses it
39	        self.id_to_params = {}
40	
41	        self.total_size = size
42	        self.total_free = size
43	        self.largest_contiguous = size
44	        self.max_allocated = 0
45	
46	        self.count = 0
47	
48	    #create a tensor of size from the pre-allocated buffer
49	    #if not enough free space will fail
50	    #if not enough contiguous space, will defragment and allocate
51	    def allocate_tensor(self, size):
52	        free_before = self.total_free
53	
54	        assert size <= self.total_free, "Not enough memory in buffer. Allocation failed"
55	        if self.largest_contiguous < size:
56	            print_rank_0("Needs defragmentation to allocate. Before Defragmentation:")
57	            self.print_allocation(resolution=100)
58	            self._defragment_memory()
59	            #set the param data to the new tensor buffer locations
60	            self._reset_param_data()
61	            print_rank_0("After defragmentation:")
62	            self.print_allocation(resolution=100)
63	
64	        self.total_free = self.total_free - size
65	
66	        allocated = self.total_size - self.total_free
67	        if allocated > self.max_allocated:
68	            self.max_allocated = allocated
69	
70	        tensor_address = self._get_new_tensor_address(size)
71	
72	        ret_tensor = self._get_new_tensor(tensor_address, size)
73	        print_rank_0(
74	            f"Free before allocation {free_before}. Allocating {size}. Free after allocation {self.total_free}. Max allocated {self.max_allocated}"
75	        )
76	        assert self.total_free + size == free_before, "Allocation bookkeeping error"
77	
78	        return ret_tensor
79	
80	    #assigns the tensor data to the param data and keeps track of the assignment
81	    #any change the underlying buffer from defragmentation will cause a
82	    #reassignment of the param data
83	    def assign_to_param(self, tensor, param, numel, shape):
84	        tensor_id = id(tensor)
85	
86	        assert tensor_id in self.tensor_map.keys(), "No such tensor allocated by the allocator."
87	        assert tensor.numel() >= numel, "Assert tensor buffer does is not large enough"
88	        assert tensor_id not in self.id_to_params.keys(), "This tensor has already been assigned to a param"
89	
90	        self.id_to_params[tensor_id] = [param]
91	
92	        replicated_tensor = tensor.narrow(0, 0, numel).view(shape)
93	        param.data = replicated_tensor.data
94	        param.contiguous_tensor_id = tensor_id
95	
96	    #deletes the tensor and frees up the underlying buffer
97	    def release_tensor(self, tensor):
98	        free_before = self.total_free
99	        tensor_id = id(tensor)
100	        tensor_size = tensor.numel()
101	        self._release_tensor(tensor_id)
102	        self._unassign_params(tensor_id)
103	        self.total_free += tensor_size
104	        print_rank_0(
105	            f"Free before release {free_before}. Released {tensor.numel()}. Total free after {self.total_free}.")
106	        assert self.total_free - tensor_size == free_before, "Release bookkeeping error"
107	
108	    def release_tensor_with_id(self, tensor_id):
109	        free_before = self.total_free
110	        assert tensor_id in self.tensor_map.keys(), "Invalid tensor id"
111	        tensor = self.tensor_map[tensor_id]
112	        tensor_size = tensor.numel()
113	        self._release_tensor(tensor_id)
114	        self._unassign_params(tensor_id)
115	        self.total_free += tensor_size
116	        print_rank_0(
117	            f"Free before release {free_before}. Released {tensor.numel()}. Total free after {self.total_free}.")
118	        assert self.total_free - tensor_size == free_before, "Release bookkeeping error"
119	
120	    #shows the current memory allocation at specified resolution
121	    def print_allocation(self, resolution=200):
122	        total_size = self.buffer.numel() * 1.0
123	        empty = []
124	        for addr, size in self.contiguous_sizes.items():
125	            start = int(addr * resolution / total_size)
126	            end = int((addr + size) * resolution / total_size)
127	            empty.extend(range(start, end))
128	        s = ''
129	        for i in range(resolution):
130	            s += '.' if i in empty else '|'
131	        print_rank_0(s)
132	
133	    def max_allocated(self):
134	        return self.max_allocated
135	
136	    #to be called after defragmentation that moves the tensor buffers
137	    #this call reassigns the data of all the parameters using the tensor buffers
138	    def _reset_param_data(self):
139	        for id, tensor in self.tensor_map.items():
140	            for param in self.id_to_params[id]:
141	                param.data = tensor.narrow(0, 0, param.numel()).view(param.data.shape).data
142	
143	    def _unassign_params(self, tensor_id):
144	        if tensor_id in self.id_to_params.keys():
145	            del self.id_to_params[tensor_id]
146	
147	    def _release_tensor(self, tensor_id):
148	        assert tensor_id in self.tensor_addresses, f"Tensor id {tensor_id} not found"
149	
150	        address = self.tensor_addresses[tensor_id]
151	        contiguous_size = self.tensor_map[tensor_id].numel()
152	
153	        del self.tensor_addresses[tensor_id]
154	        del self.tensor_ids[address]
155	        del self.tensor_map[tensor_id]
156	        del self.tensor_sizes[address]
157	
158	        self._consolidate_address(address, contiguous_size)
159	        self.largest_contiguous = self._largest_contiguous()
160	
161	    def _consolidate_address(self, address, contiguous_size):
162	
163	        #consolidate next buffer
164	        end_address = address + contiguous_size
165	        if end_address in self.contiguous_sizes:
166	            contiguous_size += self.contiguous_sizes[end_address]
167	            del self.contiguous_sizes[end_address]
168	
169	        #consolidate previous buffer
170	        for addr, size in self.contiguous_sizes.items():
171	            if addr + size == address:
172	                del self.contiguous_sizes[addr]
173	                contiguous_size += size
174	                address = addr
175	                break
176	
177	        self.contiguous_sizes[address] = contiguous_size
178	
179	    def _defragment_memory(self):
180	        empty_addresses = sorted(self.contiguous_sizes.keys())
181	        tensor_addresses = sorted(self.tensor_addresses.values())
182	
183	        tensor_index = 0
184	
185	        while tensor_index < len(tensor_addresses):
186	
187	            empty_addr = empty_addresses[0]

# Copyright (c) Microsoft Corporation.
# SPDX-License-Identifier: Apache-2.0

# DeepSpeed Team

import torch

from deepspeed import comm as dist


def print_rank_0(message):
    if dist.get_rank() == 0:
        print(message)


class ContiguousMemoryAllocator(object):

    def __init__(self, size, dtype, device):
        self.buffer = torch.zeros(size, dtype=dtype, device=device)

        #address to contiguous size available
        self.contiguous_sizes = {}

        self.contiguous_sizes[0] = size

        #tensor id to its address
        self.tensor_addresses = {}

        #tensor address to its size
        self.tensor_sizes = {}

        #tensor address to ids
        self.tensor_ids = {}

        #id to tensors
        self.tensor_map = {}

        #id to params. Maps each tensor buffer to list of parameters that uses it
        self.id_to_params = {}

        self.total_size = size
        self.total_free = size
        self.largest_contiguous = size
        self.max_allocated = 0

        self.count = 0

    #create a tensor of size from the pre-allocated buffer
    #if not enough free space will fail
    #if not enough contiguous space, will defragment and allocate
    def allocate_tensor(self, size):
        free_before = self.total_free

        assert size <= self.total_free, "Not enough memory in buffer. Allocation failed"
        if self.largest_contiguous < size:
            print_rank_0("Needs defragmentation to allocate. Before Defragmentation:")
            self.print_allocation(resolution=100)
            self._defragment_memory()
            #set the param data to the new tensor buffer locations
            self._reset_param_data()
            print_rank_0("After defragmentation:")
            self.print_allocation(resolution=100)

        self.total_free = self.total_free - size

        allocated = self.total_size - self.total_free
        if allocated > self.max_allocated:
            self.max_allocated = allocated

        tensor_address = self._get_new_tensor_address(size)

        ret_tensor = self._get_new_tensor(tensor_address, size)
        print_rank_0(
            f"Free before allocation {free_before}. Allocating {size}. Free after allocation {self.total_free}. Max allocated {self.max_allocated}"
        )
        assert self.total_free + size == free_before, "Allocation bookkeeping error"

        return ret_tensor

    #assigns the tensor data to the param data and keeps track of the assignment
    #any change the underlying buffer from defragmentation will cause a
    #reassignment of the param data
    def assign_to_param(self, tensor, param, numel, shape):
        tensor_id = id(tensor)

        assert tensor_id in self.tensor_map.keys(), "No such tensor allocated by the allocator."
        assert tensor.numel() >= numel, "Assert tensor buffer does is not large enough"
        assert tensor_id not in self.id_to_params.keys(), "This tensor has already been assigned to a param"

        self.id_to_params[tensor_id] = [param]

        replicated_tensor = tensor.narrow(0, 0, numel).view(shape)
        param.data = replicated_tensor.data
        param.contiguous_tensor_id = tensor_id

    #deletes the tensor and frees up the underlying buffer
    def release_tensor(self, tensor):
        free_before = self.total_free
        tensor_id = id(tensor)
        tensor_size = tensor.numel()
        self._release_tensor(tensor_id)
        self._unassign_params(tensor_id)
        self.total_free += tensor_size
        print_rank_0(
            f"Free before release {free_before}. Released {tensor.numel()}. Total free after {self.total_free}.")
        assert self.total_free - tensor_size == free_before, "Release bookkeeping error"

    def release_tensor_with_id(self, tensor_id):
        free_before = self.total_free
        assert tensor_id in self.tensor_map.keys(), "Invalid tensor id"
        tensor = self.tensor_map[tensor_id]
        tensor_size = tensor.numel()
        self._release_tensor(tensor_id)
        self._unassign_params(tensor_id)
        self.total_free += tensor_size
        print_rank_0(
            f"Free before release {free_before}. Released {tensor.numel()}. Total free after {self.total_free}.")
        assert self.total_free - tensor_size == free_before, "Release bookkeeping error"

    #shows the current memory allocation at specified resolution
    def print_allocation(self, resolution=200):
        total_size = self.buffer.numel() * 1.0
        empty = []
        for addr, size in self.contiguous_sizes.items():
            start = int(addr * resolution / total_size)
            end = int((addr + size) * resolution / total_size)
            empty.extend(range(start, end))
        s = ''
        for i in range(resolution):
            s += '.' if i in empty else '|'
        print_rank_0(s)

    def max_allocated(self):
        return self.max_allocated

    #to be called after defragmentation that moves the tensor buffers
    #this call reassigns the data of all the parameters using the tensor buffers
    def _reset_param_data(self):
        for id, tensor in self.tensor_map.items():
            for param in self.id_to_params[id]:
                param.data = tensor.narrow(0, 0, param.numel()).view(param.data.shape).data

    def _unassign_params(self, tensor_id):
        if tensor_id in self.id_to_params.keys():
            del self.id_to_params[tensor_id]

    def _release_tensor(self, tensor_id):
        assert tensor_id in self.tensor_addresses, f"Tensor id {tensor_id} not found"

        address = self.tensor_addresses[tensor_id]
        contiguous_size = self.tensor_map[tensor_id].numel()

        del self.tensor_addresses[tensor_id]
        del self.tensor_ids[address]
        del self.tensor_map[tensor_id]
        del self.tensor_sizes[address]

        self._consolidate_address(address, contiguous_size)
        self.largest_contiguous = self._largest_contiguous()

    def _consolidate_address(self, address, contiguous_size):

        #consolidate next buffer
        end_address = address + contiguous_size
        if end_address in self.contiguous_sizes:
            contiguous_size += self.contiguous_sizes[end_address]
            del self.contiguous_sizes[end_address]

        #consolidate previous buffer
        for addr, size in self.contiguous_sizes.items():
            if addr + size == address:
                del self.contiguous_sizes[addr]
                contiguous_size += size
                address = addr
                break

        self.contiguous_sizes[address] = contiguous_size

    def _defragment_memory(self):
        empty_addresses = sorted(self.contiguous_sizes.keys())
        tensor_addresses = sorted(self.tensor_addresses.values())

        tensor_index = 0

        while tensor_index < len(tensor_addresses):

            empty_addr = empty_addresses[0]
            empty_size = self.contiguous_sizes[empty_addr]

            tensor_addr = tensor_addresses[tensor_index]
            tensor_size = self.tensor_sizes[tensor_addr]
            tensor_id = self.tensor_ids[tensor_addr]
            tensor = self.tensor_map[self.tensor_ids[tensor_addr]]

            assert tensor_size == tensor.numel(), \
                f"Size mismatch. {tensor_size} is allocated at addr {tensor_addr} but tensor size is {tensor.numel()} "

            assert empty_addr != tensor_addr, \
                f"Cannot have same empty address {empty_addr} and tensor address {tensor_addr}"

            if empty_addr < tensor_addr:

                if empty_size >= tensor_size:
                    dest_buffer = self.buffer.narrow(0, empty_addr, tensor_size)
                    src_buffer = self.buffer.narrow(0, tensor_addr, tensor_size)
                    dest_buffer.data.copy_(src_buffer.data)
                else:

                    src_addr = tensor_addr
                    dest_addr = empty_addr
                    while src_addr < (tensor_addr + tensor_size):
                        copy_size = min(empty_size, tensor_addr + tensor_size - src_addr)

                        dest_buffer = self.buffer.narrow(0, dest_addr, copy_size)
                        src_buffer = self.buffer.narrow(0, src_addr, copy_size)

                        dest_buffer.data.copy_(src_buffer.data)

                        src_addr += copy_size
                        dest_addr += copy_size

                self._replace_old_address_with_new(tensor_id, empty_addr)

                tensor_index += 1

            else:
                tensor_index += 1

            empty_addresses = sorted(self.contiguous_sizes.keys())

    def _replace_old_address_with_new(self, tensor_id, new_address):

        tensor = self.tensor_map[tensor_id]
        tensor_size = tensor.numel()
        tensor.data = self.buffer.narrow(0, new_address, tensor_size).data

        self._release_tensor(tensor_id)
        self._mark_as_occupied(new_address, tensor_size)

        self.tensor_ids[new_address] = tensor_id
        self.tensor_map[tensor_id] = tensor
        self.tensor_addresses[tensor_id] = new_address
        self.tensor_sizes[new_address] = tensor_size

    def _get_new_tensor_address(self, size):
        tensor_address = None
        for address, contiguous_size in self.contiguous_sizes.items():
            if contiguous_size >= size and \
                    (tensor_address is None or \
                    contiguous_size < self.contiguous_sizes[tensor_address]):
                tensor_address = address
        assert tensor_address is not None, "address cannot be None"
        return tensor_address

    def _get_new_tensor(self, address, size):
        available_contiguous_size = self.contiguous_sizes[address]

        assert size <= available_contiguous_size, \
            f"Tensor numel {size} is large than available contiguous size {available_contiguous_size}"
        self.count += 1
        new_tensor = self.buffer.narrow(0, address, size)
        tensor_id = id(new_tensor)
        self.tensor_addresses[tensor_id] = address
        self.tensor_sizes[address] = size

        self.tensor_ids[address] = tensor_id
        self.tensor_map[tensor_id] = new_tensor

        self._mark_as_occupied(address, size)

        return new_tensor

    def _largest_contiguous(self):
        if len(self.contiguous_sizes) > 0:
            return max([size for _, size in self.contiguous_sizes.items()])
        else:
            return 0

    def _mark_as_occupied(self, address, size):
        available_contiguous_size = self.contiguous_sizes[address]
        del self.contiguous_sizes[address]

        if available_contiguous_size != size:
            self.contiguous_sizes[address + size] = available_contiguous_size - size

        self.largest_contiguous = self._largest_contiguous()

def _scale_gradients_in_place(optimizer):
    """The reference: every sub-group's gradients are scaled in place before a plain CPU Adam step."""
    optimizer._grad_scale_for_cpu_adam = lambda sub_group_id, total_norm: None


def _record_grad_scales(factors):

    def patch(optimizer):
        original = optimizer._grad_scale_for_cpu_adam

        def wrapped(sub_group_id, total_norm):
            factor = original(sub_group_id, total_norm)
            factors.append(factor)
            return factor

        optimizer._grad_scale_for_cpu_adam = wrapped

    return patch

@pytest.mark.parametrize("ratio", [1.0, 0.5])
@pytest.mark.parametrize("clip", [1e-3, 1e6])
@pytest.mark.parametrize("pin_memory", [True, False])
class TestZero3CpuAdamGradScale(DistributedTest):
    """For CPU sub-groups, ZeRO-3 passes the clipping factor to DeepSpeedCPUAdam, which applies it while loading each
    gradient, instead of multiplying the CPU gradients in place first. The same float multiply, so the parameters after
    training, and the gradients read after the last step, must be bitwise equal to the in-place path. Clip 1e-3 clips
    every step (factor below 1); clip 1e6 never does (factor 1)."""
    world_size = 2

    def test(self, ratio, clip, pin_memory):
        factors = []
        separate, separate_grads, _ = _train_zero3_cpu_offload(ratio,
                                                               clip,
                                                               pin_memory=pin_memory,
                                                               patch=_scale_gradients_in_place)
        fused, fused_grads, _ = _train_zero3_cpu_offload(ratio,
                                                         clip,
                                                         pin_memory=pin_memory,
                                                         patch=_record_grad_scales(factors))
        used = [f for f in factors if f is not None]
        assert used, "no sub-group took the fused path"
        assert all(f < 1.0 for f in used) if clip < 1.0 else all(f == 1.0 for f in used)
        assert len(separate) == len(fused)
        for a, b in zip(separate + separate_grads, fused + fused_grads):
            assert torch.equal(a, b)

@pytest.mark.parametrize("ratio", [1.0, 0.5])
class TestZero3CpuAdamCopyBack(DistributedTest):
    """For CPU sub-groups with pinned memory, one DeepSpeedCPUAdam pass updates the fp32 parameters and writes their
    bfloat16 copy into two pinned buffers that are copied to the device piece by piece, instead of an Adam pass followed
    by copying the fp32 master to the device and casting it there. The parameters after training must be bitwise equal
    to the separate passes. Pieces much smaller than a sub-group reuse both buffers many times per step."""
    world_size = 2

    def test(self, ratio):
        if get_accelerator().device_name() == "cpu":

        calls = []

        def record(optimizer):
            original = optimizer._cpu_adam_step_and_copy_back

            def wrapped(sub_group_id, grad_scale):
                calls.append(sub_group_id)
                return original(sub_group_id, grad_scale)

            optimizer._cpu_adam_step_and_copy_back = wrapped

        separate, _, _ = _train_zero3_cpu_offload(ratio, 1e-3, piece_numel=1000, patch=_scale_gradients_in_place)

    def _muon_update_sub_group(self, i, group_items, communication_data_type: torch.dtype):
        """Run Muon in place on full gradients, for part of sub-group `i`.

        `group_items` holds `(param, dest_offset, grad)`: `dest_offset` is the parameter's offset
        in the sub-group's partitioned momentum and `grad` its full-shape gradient. Each rank
        orthogonalizes a round-robin share of the parameters, then the updates and momentums are
        all-gathered, so every rank ends with the full update in `grad` and its own momentum
        partition written back.
        """
        from deepspeed.runtime.zero.muon.original_muon import muon_update
        params = [param for param, _, _ in group_items]
        grads = [grad for _, _, grad in group_items]
        if not params:
            return

        momentum_buffer = []
        if self._swappable_optimizer_subgroup(i) and not self.save_muon_momentum_buffer_in_memory:
            # swap-in once, keep resident through update + writeback
            self.optimizer_swapper.swap_in_optimizer_state(parameter=self.fp32_partitioned_groups_flat[i])
            if "momentum_buffer" not in self.optimizer.state.get(self.fp32_partitioned_groups_flat[i], {}):
                self._create_momentum_buffer(self.fp16_partitioned_groups_flat_numel[i], i,
                                             self.fp32_partitioned_groups_flat[i].ds_id)
            state_buffer = self.optimizer.state[self.fp32_partitioned_groups_flat[i]]["momentum_buffer"]
            for param, dest_offset, _ in group_items:
                momentum_buffer.append(state_buffer.narrow(0, dest_offset, param.partition_numel()).clone())
        elif self.save_muon_momentum_buffer_in_memory:
            state_buffer = self.muon_momentum_buffer_partitioned_groups_flat[i]
            for param, dest_offset, _ in group_items:
                momentum_buffer.append(state_buffer.narrow(0, dest_offset, param.partition_numel()).clone())

def zero_grad(self, set_to_none=True):
        """
        Zero FP16 parameter grads.
        """
        self.micro_step_id = 0
        # Reset the epilogue flag so the next forward doesn't increment micro_step_id.
        # Without this, calling zero_grad() between backward and forward would cause
        # micro_step_id to be incremented at the next forward, leading to incorrect
        # gradient accumulation behavior.
        self._epilogue_ran_this_backward = False

        # FP32 grad should never exist.
        # For speed, set model fp16 grad to None by default
        for group in self.fp16_groups:
            for p in group:
                if set_to_none:
                    if p.grad is not None and get_accelerator().on_accelerator(p.grad):
                        p.grad.record_stream(get_accelerator().current_stream())
                    p.grad = None
                else:
                    if p.grad is not None:
                        p.grad.detach_()
                        p.grad.zero_()

    def clear_backward_seen_flag(self):
        """Clear the backward seen flag and increment micro_step_id if epilogue ran.

        This override defers the micro_step_id increment from the epilogue to here.
        With reentrant gradient checkpointing, the epilogue may be called multiple
        times per backward pass, but we only want to increment micro_step_id once
        after the backward is complete. By incrementing here at the start of the
        NEXT forward, all phases within a backward use the same micro_step_id value.
        """
        # Increment micro_step_id if the epilogue ran during the previous backward.
        # This is deferred from independent_gradient_partition_epilogue() to ensure
        # all phases within a backward use the same micro_step_id (copy semantics).
        if self._epilogue_ran_this_backward:
            self.micro_step_id += 1

        # Call base class to reset flags (including _epilogue_ran_this_backward)
        super().clear_backward_seen_flag()

    def _model_parallel_all_reduce(self, tensor, op):
        """ Perform all reduce within model parallel group, if any.
        """

        def train(engine, batch):
            loss = engine(batch[0], batch[1])
            engine.backward(loss)
            engine.step()

        def one_copy(engine):
            optimizer = engine.optimizer
            masters = optimizer.fp32_partitioned_groups_flat
            weights = optimizer.fp16_partitioned_groups_flat
            buffer = optimizer.lp_param_buffer.untyped_storage().data_ptr()
            return (all(master is weight for master, weight in zip(masters, weights))
                    and all(p.ds_tensor.untyped_storage().data_ptr() == buffer for p in engine.module.parameters()))

        engine = build()
        reference = build()
        assert one_copy(engine)
        batches = list(
            random_dataloader(model=engine,
                              total_samples=6,
                              hidden_dim=hidden_dim,
                              device=engine.device,
                              dtype=torch.float32))
        lp_bytes = engine.optimizer.lp_param_buffer.numel() * engine.optimizer.lp_param_buffer.element_size()
        # A weight round trip first (the master holds the same storage, which must not keep it on the device), then
        # a master round trip and a step before the next weight round trip (two copies would part there).
        rounds = [[OffloadStateTypeEnum.lp_params], [OffloadStateTypeEnum.hp_params], [OffloadStateTypeEnum.lp_params],
                  [OffloadStateTypeEnum.hp_params, OffloadStateTypeEnum.lp_params], None]
        for batch, include in zip(batches, rounds):
            train(engine, batch)
            train(reference, batch)
            weights_before = [p.ds_tensor.clone() for p in engine.module.parameters()]
            # offload_states first releases the gathered parameters ZeRO-3 keeps after a step; release them here so
            # that only the offload itself is measured.
            engine.empty_partition_cache()
            alloc_before = get_accelerator().memory_allocated()
            engine.offload_states(include=include, device=OffloadDeviceEnum.cpu, pin_memory=pin_memory)
            freed = alloc_before - get_accelerator().memory_allocated()
            if allocator_backed_memory_stats and offload_leaves_accelerator and (
                    include is None or OffloadStateTypeEnum.lp_params in include):
                assert freed >= lp_bytes, f"offloading lp_params freed {freed} bytes, the weights take {lp_bytes}"
            engine.reload_states()
            for before, param in zip(weights_before, engine.module.parameters()):
                assert torch.equal(before, param.ds_tensor), f"weights changed across offloading {include}"
            assert one_copy(engine), f"master and weights are two copies after offloading {include}"

        train(engine, batches[-1])
        train(reference, batches[-1])
        for param, reference_param in zip(engine.module.parameters(), reference.module.parameters()):
            assert torch.equal(param.ds_tensor, reference_param.ds_tensor)
        engine.destroy()
        reference.destroy()

# ZeRO-3 优化器：stage3 主循环与连续内存

> 对应源码版本：HEAD `84481c33`（本讲在 u5-l5 之后，聚焦 `DeepSpeedZeroOptimizer_Stage3` 这个"训练期大脑"）。

## 1. 本讲目标

学完本讲，你应该能够：

1. 按顺序列出 `DeepSpeedZeroOptimizer_Stage3.step()` 的完整阶段：预清理 → 溢出检查 → 全局范数 → 逐子组「缩放梯度 → 更新 fp32 分区 → 写回 ds_tensor」→ 收尾，并说清 reduce-scatter 参数梯度与更新 `ds_tensor` 的先后关系。
2. 解释 IPG（独立并行梯度）桶如何把反向梯度归约与计算重叠，`reduce_bucket_size`、`contiguous_gradients` 与 `reduce_scatter` 三个配置如何影响通信路径与显存。
3. 说明 partial offload（`offload_optimizer.ratio`）时子组设备串 `subgroup_to_device` 如何通过公共加速器 API `get_accelerator().device_name()` 构造，而不用任何私有属性。
4. 解读 `aliased_fp32_sub_groups`（权重分区即 master 副本）：fp32 模型（含 autocast）下 ZeRO-3 为什么可以少存一份权重，以及这给 `offload_states`/`reload_states` 带来的「必须随 lp_params 一起搬」约束。
5. 理解 `ContiguousMemoryAllocator` 如何用一块预分配平坦缓冲 + 地址簿 + 搬移式碎片整理来对抗显存碎片。
6. 精读本周期 #8841 的融合 CPU Adam 步：`_grad_scale_for_cpu_adam` 判定、`_deferred_grad_scale` 延迟补乘、以及双 pinned bf16 缓冲流水拷回 `_cpu_adam_step_and_copy_back`，并说明为什么它们与旧路径**逐位一致**。

## 2. 前置知识

本讲默认你已读过：

- **u5-l1**：ZeRO 三阶段的显存公式（混合精度 + Adam 下每卡模型状态约 16Ψ 字节；stage 3 把参数、梯度、优化器状态全部按数据并行度切分）。
- **u5-l2**：`zero.Init` 如何在模型构造期就把参数切成 `ds_tensor` 分区；参数本体只是 0 元素占位符。
- **u5-l5**：前向/反向 hook 如何按需 all-gather 参数（`ds_status` 三态轮转），参数协调器如何预取与释放。本讲的 `step()` 就发生在一次完整 backward 结束、所有梯度已落入本 rank 梯度分区之后。
- **u4-l1**：fp16 动态 loss scaling 的溢出检测与 scale 调整规则。stage3 与 stage1/2 共享这套机制，本讲的融合路径必须证明自己在溢出跳步时与旧路径一致。
- **u5-l4**：`DeepSpeedCPUAdam` 的「薄 Python 壳 + C++ SIMD 内核」结构与 pinned memory 的作用。本讲的 #8841 正是给这个内核加料。

补充几个本讲反复出现的术语：

| 术语 | 含义 |
| --- | --- |
| 子组（sub-group） | stage3 把本 rank 的全部参数分区按 `sub_group_size`（默认极大）分批，每批摊平成**一块**平坦缓冲、作为一个整体做优化器更新 |
| IPG 桶 | 反向传播中暂存"已就绪梯度"的连续缓冲，桶满立即归约，实现通信与计算重叠 |
| master 权重（hp） | fp32 主权重分区 `fp32_partitioned_groups_flat`；对应的低精度权重分区是 `fp16_partitioned_groups_flat`（历史命名，bf16 也走这里） |
| pinned memory | 页锁定主机内存，`non_blocking=True` 的 H2D/D2H 拷贝只有从 pinned 内存发出才是真异步 |
| 请求/累积窗口 | 两次 `step()` 之间的全部 micro-batch backward；本讲的"延迟梯度缩放"以窗口为单位记账 |

## 3. 本讲源码地图

| 文件 | 作用 |
| --- | --- |
| [deepspeed/runtime/zero/stage3.py](https://github.com/deepspeedai/DeepSpeed/blob/84481c333875abc8a47f1b0d07fdadddb8d70fd8/deepspeed/runtime/zero/stage3.py) | 本讲主战场：`DeepSpeedZeroOptimizer_Stage3` 的 step 主循环、IPG 桶、子组设备分配、`offload_states`、融合 CPU Adam 步 |
| [deepspeed/runtime/zero/contiguous_memory_allocator.py](https://github.com/deepspeedai/DeepSpeed/blob/84481c333875abc8a47f1b0d07fdadddb8d70fd8/deepspeed/runtime/zero/contiguous_memory_allocator.py) | 平坦缓冲碎片整理分配器（all-gather 的连续显存来源） |
| [deepspeed/runtime/zero/partitioned_param_profiler.py](https://github.com/deepspeedai/DeepSpeed/blob/84481c333875abc8a47f1b0d07fdadddb8d70fd8/deepspeed/runtime/zero/partitioned_param_profiler.py) | 参数 all-gather 事件的计时/计数器，实践任务用它观测通信 |

| [csrc/adam/cpu_adam.cpp](https://github.com/deepspeedai/DeepSpeed/blob/84481c333875abc8a47f1b0d07fdadddb8d70fd8/csrc/adam/cpu_adam.cpp) / [csrc/adam/cpu_adam_impl.cpp](https://github.com/deepspeedai/DeepSpeed/blob/84481c333875abc8a47f1b0d07fdadddb8d70fd8/csrc/adam/cpu_adam_impl.cpp) | CPU Adam 内核入口与实现：`adam_update_scaled(_copy)`、能力探测、向量块对齐 |
| [tests/unit/v1/zero/test_zero.py](https://github.com/deepspeedai/DeepSpeed/blob/84481c333875abc8a47f1b0d07fdadddb8d70fd8/tests/unit/v1/zero/test_zero.py) | 本周期新增的四个融合路径回归测试（GradScale/CopyBack/UnusedLayer/Fp16Overflow） |
| [tests/unit/v1/zero/test_offload_states.py](https://github.com/deepspeedai/DeepSpeed/blob/84481c333875abc8a47f1b0d07fdadddb8d70fd8/tests/unit/v1/zero/test_offload_states.py) | `TestOffloadStatesZero3AliasedMaster`：aliased master 的搬运回归 |

## 4. 核心概念与源码讲解

### 4.1 stage3 step 主循环：从梯度分区到 ds_tensor 更新

#### 4.1.1 概念说明

`DeepSpeedZeroOptimizer_Stage3` 是 ZeRO-3 的"训练期大脑"。u5-l5 讲的参数协调器负责**前向/反向**把参数分区按需拼成完整参数；本讲的对象则在**一次累积窗口结束**时接管：把本 rank 持有的梯度分区变成参数更新。它管理的三块核心状态：

- `fp16_groups` / `fp16_partitioned_groups_flat`：本 rank 的低精度**权重**分区（摊平后每子组一块）；
- `fp32_partitioned_groups_flat`：fp32 **master 权重**分区（优化器真正更新的对象）；
- `grad_partitions_flat_buffers`：按累积 dtype 分桶的平坦**梯度**分区（一或多个 dtype 一块）。

step 要做的事本质上就是：`master += -lr * adam(master.grad)`，然后把 master 降精度写回权重分区，供下一个 forward 的 all-gather 使用。

#### 4.1.2 核心流程

`step()`（[stage3.py:3050-3138](https://github.com/deepspeedai/DeepSpeed/blob/84481c333875abc8a47f1b0d07fdadddb8d70fd8/deepspeed/runtime/zero/stage3.py#L3050-L3138)）的阶段顺序：

```text
1. _pre_step()
   ├─ micro_step_id 归零
   ├─ _apply_all_deferred_grad_scales()   ← 融合路径的补乘，必须在溢出检查之前
   ├─ _offload_grad_written_ids = set()   ← 记录"本窗口写过哪些梯度"的集合清空
   └─ 清空 IPG 桶残留参数（reentrant checkpointing 防御）
2. _partition_all_parameters()            ← 把 step 间隙残留的完整参数重新切回分区
3. 溢出检查（update_scale=False，原始溢出在 Muon 之前判）
   → 无溢出则 _apply_muon_to_accumulated_grads + 各组范数合并成 scaled_global_grad_norm
4. _loss_scale_update_and_overflow_cleanup()
   → 溢出则清梯度、降 scale、直接 return（跳过整个更新）
5. 记录无缩放范数 self._global_grad_norm = norm / loss_scale
6. 逐子组循环（核心，见 6.）：
   for sub_group_id in fp16_groups:
       a. _prepare_sub_group        （NVMe 子组换入 / 非卸载路径准备 fp32 梯度）
       b. grad_scale = _grad_scale_for_cpu_adam(...)
          - None      → unscale_and_clip_grads（就地缩放旧路径）
          - != 1.0    → 记入 _deferred_grad_scale（融合路径不就地缩放）
       c. 更新：
          - 融合+拷回成立 → _cpu_adam_step_and_copy_back（一遍内核完成更新+bf16 写回）
          - 否则          → _optimizer_step（可带 grad_scale）
                            + _reassign_or_swap_out_partitioned_parameters
                            （把 fp32 master 降精度拷回权重分区 → ds_tensor 分区）
       d. _release_sub_group        （释放 fp32 梯度 / NVMe 子组换出）
7. _post_step()（offload 时 reset_cpu_buffers；收集持久参数；失效 hpZ 副本）
8. 检查 caching allocator 重试次数并告警
```

注意顺序要点：**梯度归约（reduce-scatter）不在 step 里发生**——它发生在 backward 的梯度 hook 中（见 4.2）；step 拿到的是已经 reduce-scatter 落位、且已跨 micro-batch 累积完的梯度分区。step 内部对每个子组先缩放、再更新 master、最后写回 `ds_tensor`。

#### 4.1.3 源码精读

step 主体与逐子组循环（引用处为当前 HEAD 真实行号）：

- [stage3.py:3088-3116](https://github.com/deepspeedai/DeepSpeed/blob/84481c333875abc8a47f1b0d07fdadddb8d70fd8/deepspeed/runtime/zero/stage3.py#L3088-L3116)：逐子组更新循环。`_prepare_sub_group` 之后，第 3096 行先问 `_grad_scale_for_cpu_adam`；为 `None` 走就地缩放 `unscale_and_clip_grads`，否则把因子交给内核或记入 `_deferred_grad_scale`；第 3102 行若同时满足拷回条件则走一遍式 `_cpu_adam_step_and_copy_back`，否则传统的 `_optimizer_step` + `_reassign_or_swap_out_partitioned_parameters`。
- [stage3.py:3027-3042](https://github.com/deepspeedai/DeepSpeed/blob/84481c333875abc8a47f1b0d07fdadddb8d70fd8/deepspeed/runtime/zero/stage3.py#L3027-L3042)：`_reassign_or_swap_out_partitioned_parameters` —— 把更新后的 fp32 master 拷回低精度权重分区并 `_unflatten_partitioned_parameters` 重新铺到各参数的 `ds_tensor`；pinned master 走 `_copy_pinned_master_to_device`（master 以自身 dtype 上设备、在设备上做 cast，这是 #5301 引入的省 CPU 端 pageable 临时拷贝的形式）。
- [stage3.py:2893-2898](https://github.com/deepspeedai/DeepSpeed/blob/84481c333875abc8a47f1b0d07fdadddb8d70fd8/deepspeed/runtime/zero/stage3.py#L2893-L2898)：`_unflatten_partitioned_parameters` —— 按子组把平坦缓冲切片赋回 `partitioned_param.data`，即"更新最终落到 ds_tensor 分区"的那一步。
- [stage3.py:2636-2661](https://github.com/deepspeedai/DeepSpeed/blob/84481c333875abc8a47f1b0d07fdadddb8d70fd8/deepspeed/runtime/zero/stage3.py#L2636-L2661)：`_pre_step`。注释明确说明 `_apply_all_deferred_grad_scales` 要放在溢出检查之前，这样被跳过的 step 也让梯度保持在"与就地缩放完全相同"的状态。
- [stage3.py:3082-3085](https://github.com/deepspeedai/DeepSpeed/blob/84481c333875abc8a47f1b0d07fdadddb8d70fd8/deepspeed/runtime/zero/stage3.py#L3082-L3085)：非卸载路径下梯度已在 epilogue 拷进分区缓冲，这里**一次性** `zero_grad(set_to_none=True)` 清模型梯度，而不是每个子组访问一遍全部参数（性能细节）。
- 溢出检查按 dtype 遍历所有梯度缓冲：[stage3.py:3243-3253](https://github.com/deepspeedai/DeepSpeed/blob/84481c333875abc8a47f1b0d07fdadddb8d70fd8/deepspeed/runtime/zero/stage3.py#L3243-L3253)（`for grad_buffer in self.grad_partitions_flat_buffers.values()`，fp32 保真参数有自己的缓冲，见 4.2.3）。这与 stage1/2 共享的 loss scaling 语义一致（u4-l1）。

#### 4.1.4 代码实践

1. **实践目标**：把 step() 的阶段清单落到真实行号上，形成一张可复查的地图。
2. **操作步骤**：
   - 打开 [stage3.py:3050](https://github.com/deepspeedai/DeepSpeed/blob/84481c333875abc8a47f1b0d07fdadddb8d70fd8/deepspeed/runtime/zero/stage3.py#L3050) 起，按 4.1.2 的 8 个阶段逐段找到对应方法与行号，抄成表格。

3. **需要观察的现象**：每个子组固定按 `prepare → scale → step → reassign → release` 打印；卸载路径下 `unscale_and_clip_grads` 可能完全不再打印（被融合路径替代，见 4.6）。
4. **预期结果**：阶段顺序与本节流程图一致；若你在 DeepSpeedCPUAdam 卸载 + bf16 + pin_memory 的配置下运行，`_optimizer_step` 与 `_reassign...` 的打印会消失，取而代之的是 `_cpu_adam_step_and_copy_back`。
5. 本地无 GPU 时可参照 tests/unit/v1 的 CPU 多进程方式运行（见 4.6.4），实际输出**待本地验证**。

#### 4.1.5 小练习与答案

**练习 1**：为什么 step 开头要先 `_apply_all_deferred_grad_scales()` 再做溢出检查，反过来行不行？

**答案**：不行。延迟补乘的目标是"让梯度在 step 结束后看起来和就地缩放路径完全一样"。就地路径里，无论后续是否溢出跳步，梯度都已被乘过因子；若把补乘放到溢出检查之后，被跳过的 step 会留下未缩放的梯度，而下一次 step 或任何 `safe_get_full_grad` 读取都会再次用到它，两条路径的梯度值就会分叉。源码注释（[stage3.py:2639-2640](https://github.com/deepspeedai/DeepSpeed/blob/84481c333875abc8a47f1b0d07fdadddb8d70fd8/deepspeed/runtime/zero/stage3.py#L2639-L2640)）明确写了这一点。

**练习 2**：`self._global_grad_norm = scaled_global_grad_norm / self.loss_scale`（[stage3.py:3075](https://github.com/deepspeedai/DeepSpeed/blob/84481c333875abc8a47f1b0d07fdadddb8d70fd8/deepspeed/runtime/zero/stage3.py#L3075)）为什么除以 loss_scale？

**答案**：fp16 训练中梯度全程带着 loss scale（u4-l1），范数是对"已放大"的梯度算的；除回得到真实范数，供日志与 `clip_grad` 语义使用。`_combined_grad_scale`（4.6.3）内部也做了同样的 `(total_norm / self.loss_scale + 1e-6) / self.clip_grad` 换算。

### 4.2 IPG 梯度桶：reduce_bucket、按 dtype 分桶与两条归约路径

#### 4.2.1 概念说明

ZeRO-3 反向时每个参数的梯度 hook 触发后，梯度并不立即通信，而是先进入 IPG（Independent Parallel Gradients）桶；桶满或跨进程组时立即 flush：对参数分区组做 **reduce-scatter**（默认）或 **all-reduce**（`reduce_scatter: false` 时先 all-reduce 再各取所需），每个 rank 拿到属于自己的那份梯度分区。这样把通信切成分桶批次，与剩余的反向计算重叠。`reduce_bucket_size`（默认 5e8 元素）决定桶容量——桶越大单次通信越大、launch 开销越低，但驻留显存越多；`contiguous_gradients`（默认 true）决定梯度是否先拷进桶的连续切片再归约。

#### 4.2.2 核心流程

```text
backward 中某参数梯度就绪
  → reduce_independent_p_g_buckets_and_remove_grads(param)
      ├─ 进程组变了 → 先 flush 旧桶
      ├─ 桶容量不够且桶非空 → flush
      └─ __add_grad_to_ipg_bucket(param)
           contiguous_gradients 时把 param.grad 拷进 bucket.buffer 的尾部切片
flush（__reduce_and_partition_ipg_grads，在专用 reduce_and_partition_stream 上）
  ├─ contiguous_gradients 且 未超容量 且 reduce_scatter=False
  │     → __avg_scatter_contiguous_grads(整块桶缓冲)     ← all-reduce 路径
  ├─ 否则 → __avg_scatter_grads(逐参数)                 ← reduce-scatter 路径
  └─ partition_grads(...)：结果累进 grad_partitions_flat_buffers 中该参数的切片
       卸载时在累积边界把梯度拷去 CPU 的 fp32 梯度缓冲
```

桶本身是按**通信 dtype** 分开的一组（`ipg_buckets: Dict[torch.dtype, IPGBucketZ3]`）：fp32 保真参数（`data_types.keep_in_fp32_modules` 点名的，见 u5-l9）用 fp32 桶，其余用训练 dtype 的桶——把保真参数的梯度舍到 bf16 再归约会让"保真"失去意义。
